notes.TWN: 1946–1971 年聯合國的中國席位由中華民國代表，資料集記為台灣（COW 代碼 713），這裡放在台灣。1971 年 10 月 25 日聯大第 2758 號決議改由中華人民共和國代表中國，中華民國在表決前宣布退出聯合國；1971 年只有到 10 月 25 日為止的 4 次表決，1972 年起沒有投票紀錄。
notes.CHN: 1971 年 10 月 25 日聯大第 2758 號決議後由中華人民共和國代表中國，11 月 15 日起出席，1971 年的值只有之後的 25 次表決。1946–1971 年中國席位上的投票（中華民國）放在台灣。
notes.RUS: 1946–1991 年是蘇聯（資料集的 COW 代碼 365 從蘇聯接續到俄羅斯）。
notes.UKR: 1946–1991 年是烏克蘭蘇維埃社會主義共和國：跟白俄羅斯一樣，在蘇聯時期就是聯合國的創始會員國，有自己的席位與投票。
notes.BLR: 1946–1991 年是白俄羅斯蘇維埃社會主義共和國：跟烏克蘭一樣，在蘇聯時期就是聯合國的創始會員國，有自己的席位與投票。
notes.DEU: 1973–1989 年是西德（兩德 1973 年 9 月同時加入聯合國）；東德另外投票，地圖上沒有它的形狀，所以沒有放。
notes.SVK: 1993 年起才有投票紀錄，之前是捷克斯洛伐克的一部分（放在捷克）。
notes.SRB: 1946–1991 年是南斯拉夫社會主義聯邦共和國，1992–2005 年是南斯拉夫聯盟共和國（2003 年改名塞爾維亞與蒙特內哥羅；1992 年 9 月到 2000 年 10 月沒有參加大會），2006 年起是塞爾維亞。
notes.YEM: 1947–1989 年是北葉門（葉門阿拉伯共和國）；南葉門（1967–1990 年的會員國）地圖上沒有它的形狀，所以沒有放。
notes.TZA: 1961–1963 年是坦干依喀；尚吉巴 1963 年 12 月加入聯合國、1964 年 4 月跟坦干依喀合併，1963 年尚吉巴的投票沒有放。
notes.EGY: 1958–1961 年是埃及與敘利亞合組的阿拉伯聯合共和國，投票記在埃及。
notes.SYR: 1958–1961 年跟埃及合組阿拉伯聯合共和國，這段期間的投票記在埃及；1961 年 9 月退出後恢復自己的席位。
notes.ZAF: 1974 年 11 月起大會不讓南非代表團參加（種族隔離政策），1994 年 6 月恢復，所以 1975–1993 年沒有投票紀錄。
notes.IDN: 1965 年 1 月宣布退出聯合國，1966 年 9 月回來，所以 1965 年沒有投票紀錄。
notes.CHE: 2002 年 9 月才加入聯合國，之前是觀察員。
notes.GBR: 這張圖是各國跟英國的投票一致度，英國本身沒有值。

notesEn.TWN: From 1946 to 1971 China's seat in the UN was held by the Republic of China; the dataset records these votes as Taiwan (COW code 713), and they are shown here. On 25 October 1971 General Assembly Resolution 2758 gave the seat to the People's Republic of China, and the Republic of China announced its withdrawal from the UN before the vote. 1971 has only 4 votes, up to 25 October; there are no votes from 1972.
notesEn.CHN: The People's Republic of China has represented China since General Assembly Resolution 2758 of 25 October 1971 and took part from 15 November, so 1971 covers only the 25 votes after that. Votes cast in China's seat in 1946–1971 (by the Republic of China) are shown under Taiwan.
notesEn.RUS: 1946–1991 is the Soviet Union (the dataset's COW code 365 continues from the USSR to Russia).
notesEn.UKR: 1946–1991 is the Ukrainian SSR, which, like Byelorussia, was a founding UN member with its own seat and vote while part of the Soviet Union.
notesEn.BLR: 1946–1991 is the Byelorussian SSR, which, like Ukraine, was a founding UN member with its own seat and vote while part of the Soviet Union.
notesEn.DEU: 1973–1989 is West Germany (both German states joined the UN in September 1973); East Germany voted separately and has no shape on today's map, so it is not shown.
notesEn.SVK: Votes only from 1993; before that Slovakia was part of Czechoslovakia (shown under Czechia).
notesEn.SRB: 1946–1991 is socialist Yugoslavia, 1992–2005 the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (renamed Serbia and Montenegro in 2003; it did not take part in the General Assembly from September 1992 to October 2000), and Serbia from 2006.
notesEn.YEM: 1947–1989 is North Yemen (Yemen Arab Republic); South Yemen (a member in 1967–1990) has no shape on today's map, so it is not shown.
notesEn.TZA: 1961–1963 is Tanganyika; Zanzibar joined the UN in December 1963 and merged with Tanganyika in April 1964, and its 1963 votes are not shown.
notesEn.EGY: 1958–1961 is the United Arab Republic of Egypt and Syria, whose votes are recorded under Egypt.
notesEn.SYR: In 1958–1961 Syria formed the United Arab Republic with Egypt, and its votes are recorded under Egypt; Syria resumed its own seat after leaving in September 1961.
notesEn.ZAF: From November 1974 the General Assembly barred South Africa's delegation from taking part (over apartheid) until June 1994, so there are no votes in 1975–1993.
notesEn.IDN: Indonesia announced its withdrawal from the UN in January 1965 and returned in September 1966, so there are no votes in 1965.
notesEn.CHE: Switzerland joined the UN only in September 2002 and was an observer before.
notesEn.GBR: This map shows each country's voting agreement with the United Kingdom, so the United Kingdom itself has no value.
